IF DEFTS FAILS TO VACATE BY 01-NOV-96, ALL UNPAID BACK RENT & $25 DAMAGES PER DAY FRM 15-OCT-96 TO 01-NOV-96, ATTY'S FEES & COSTS SHALL BECOME DUE & OWING. SEE JUDGMENT FOR DETAILS
